uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: The user builds up rage when attacking with basic attacks or moves. Once 14 rage has been reached, the user gains 15% SpAtk for 8s, reduces move cooldowns by 65% of their current cooldown, and empowers move effects for 8s. Afterwards the ability goes on cooldown for 10s. If no rage is gained for 5s, it will begin to deplete at a rate of 1 every 0.5s.

The user shoots a small flame at the designated target. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, breathing fire and dealing damage in an area. Basic attacks increase rage by 1, boosted attacks increase rage by 2.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.

The user shoots a small flame at up to 2 opposing Pokémon in an area around the user. Increases rage by 2 per hit. At peak rage, this move will target up to 3 opposing Pokémon and inflicts a burn for 2s, dealing damage once per second up to 3 times.

The user launches 3 flames skyward, over the next 2 seconds these flames crash down on opposing Pokémon in the area. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 20% less damage for the second hit, and 40% less damage for the third hit and beyond. Increases rage by 2 per hit. At peak rage, 4 flames are launched skyward.
Increases the damage of this move.

The user charges in the designated direction, slamming into opposing Pokémon, slowing them by 30% for 1s, and granting the user a shield for 2s. Afterwards the user readies a boosted attack. Increases rage by 2 when it hits. At peak rage, this move instead stuns opposing Pokémon for 0.5s.

The user cloaks themselves in fire becoming Unstoppable, and charges in the designated direction dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit, stunning them for 0.45s, and granting the user a shield for 3s. If an opposing Pokémon or wall was hit, the user jumps into the air and can move around, after a short delay the user crashes down dealing damage in an area, slowing opposing Pokémon by 50% for 1s. Afterwards the user readies a boosted attack. Increases rage by 2 for each hit. At peak rage, this move instead throws opposing Pokémon for 0.5s when crashing down.
Increases the strength of the shield.

The user momentarily becomes Unstoppable and creates a shockwave, dealing damage 4 times simultaneously, and shoving opposing Pokémon away to the edge of the move's range. Afterwards an area around the user is engulfed in flames for 4.5s, dealing damage every 0.5s up to 10 times. Increases rage by 14. The user becomes camouflaged while the flames are raging, opposing Pokémon outside of the flames are unable to target the user.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
